title: generate_p2p_token params
description: Adds a P2P token to the running p2p server, which registers it with its broker, and refreshes it, from its punch socket. With peer_pub_b64 the token is the static token derived from both keys; without it, the server's random token is returned, or a random token is added when it has none. Fails with p2p_server_not_running when no p2p server runs and with broker_addr_mismatch when broker_addr is not the server's broker.

broker_addr.description: Broker address. Must be the broker_addr the p2p server was started with.

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of the target peer.
